blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Police authorities in the Soccsksargen (Region 12) have created a Special Investigation Task Group (SITG) to speed up the investigation and bring to justice the suspects in the killing of a police officer in Kidapawan City, North Cotabato, on Monday afternoon. Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, director of the Police Regional Office-12 (PRO-12), created SITG-Pandulo on Tuesday morning and named Col. Nathaniel Villegas, PRO-12 deputy regional director for operations, as its chairperson. Col. Argie Celeste, Kidapawan police chief, and Col. Ramel Hojilla, North Cotabato police director, are among its members. READ: PNP orders probe, manhunt over death of Lanao […]...
